title: Thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure (plane strain, quarter model)
description:
Long thick-walled steel cylinder (pipe) under internal pressure, analysed in plane strain (axial strain zero: the ends are restrained axially). By symmetry only the quarter cross-section in the first quadrant is modelled (STEP: a planar face in the xy-plane).
Geometry: quarter annulus centred on the origin, bore radius a = 0.1 m, outer radius b = 0.2 m, x >= 0 and y >= 0. Edges: straight edge on y = 0 from (a, 0) to (b, 0); outer arc r = b; straight edge on x = 0 from (0, b) to (0, a); bore arc r = a.
Material: linear elastic, E = 2e+11 Pa, nu = 0.3. Out-of-plane thickness 1.0 m (report energies per this thickness).
Loads: uniform internal pressure p = 1e+08 Pa (100 MPa) on the bore arc. The outer arc is traction free.
Supports: symmetry on x = 0 (u_x = 0) and on y = 0 (u_y = 0); nothing else.
Report (SI units):
  ur_bore      radial displacement at the bore, u_x at (a, 0) [m]
  hoop_bore    hoop stress at the bore, sigma_yy at (a, 0) [Pa]
  szz_bore     out-of-plane (axial) stress sigma_zz at (a, 0) [Pa]
  vm_max       maximum von Mises stress in the section (including sigma_zz) [Pa]
  strain_energy total strain energy of the modelled quarter, for the given thickness [J]
